vc_checking.summary: All seven cleaned manual obligations are semantically provable under the current annotation and case-lib seed. The proof family is a single coherent DLL insertion/reassembly cluster: open and split xizi_dllseg, derive address inequalities from segment guards or disjoint owned fields, use first-occurrence/no-anchor list facts for xizi_double_link_insert_before_nodes, then join segments and close xizi_dll. No witness requires changing annotation, generated statements, or seed spec declarations.

analysis_groups.shared_proof_pattern: Open the circular DLL into sentinel links plus a finite dllseg, split or join the segment at the anchor/predecessor cut, preserve all owned stores, normalize the list-level insertion equation, and close the resulting DLL. Contract derivations instantiate dispatch_case with the same abstract head/nodes and discharge their wand by rewriting the post list.
analysis_groups.shared_space_plan: Use xizi_dll_open/xizi_dll_close or their definitions; recursively split a dllseg at the first anchor and recursively join adjacent dllseg pieces. Field ownership supplies required node inequalities without dropping resources.
analysis_groups.shared_pure_plan: Use first-occurrence decomposition for member anchors, prove insertion before the first occurrence, derive that every xizi_dll node differs from the sentinel, and therefore reduce sentinel insertion to app(nodes,[inserted]).
analysis_groups.shared_refinement_plan: No safeExec or abstract-program refinement state occurs in these direct separation-logic VCs.
candidate_helper_declarations: first occurrence decomposition and xizi_double_link_insert_before_nodes first-occurrence rewrite
xizi_dllseg split-at-anchor and adjacent-segment join entailments
xizi_dll entails that the sentinel is not In its abstract nodes, preserving the DLL resource
xizi_double_link_insert_before_nodes appends when the anchor is absent
disjoint owned next fields or links imply distinct node addresses
analysis_groups.grouping_reason: All targets come from one straight-line update and share the same xizi_dll/xizi_dllseg definitions, list transformation, inequality facts, and fold/unfold helper family. Seven witnesses are below the controller limit of twelve, so one worker can reuse helpers and context without any cross-group dependency.

For anchor=head, nodes=nil selects the empty-sentinel branch; otherwise write nodes=prefix0++[prev] and select the nonempty-sentinel branch.

In the sentinel case use the empty segment equations or split at the last node. Unfold xizi_dll_links only at final cancellation; retain xizi_dll_node and the variable store.

In the sentinel branch use dllseg guards to establish ~In head nodes, then the anchor-absent append lemma. Obtain any needed node inequalities from segment guards or disjoint owned fields.
premise_discharge: The member split premise In linklist_pre nodes is exactly the left anchor case.
The sentinel equality linklist_pre=head is exactly the right anchor case.
Every abstract node differs from head by the nonempty guard in xizi_dllseg; induction discharges ~In head nodes.
Standalone-node and list-node distinctness follows from disjoint ownership of their next-field stores when required.

proof_groups.proof_strategy: Prove a small group-suffixed helper family for first-occurrence/list insertion, dllseg split/join, sentinel exclusion, and owned-field address inequality.
